teacher_token_target.finding: For two valid views, pairwise-consensus medoid selection is an exact tie and is resolved by floating-point ordering. Recomputing from fp16 tensors disagrees with the cache record for 188 of 768 training rows and 56 of 192 validation rows, all with two views.
teacher_token_target.registered_change: Replace the medoid token loss only in the response-enabled candidate with the per-region mean cosine loss over every valid frozen teacher token.
invariances: each region has equal weight independent of valid-view count
teacher_token_target.unchanged: Descriptor teacher remains the frozen all-view target and legacy/default training remains byte-contract compatible.

text_direction_gauge.finding: The uncentered 806-query fit bank places 69.74 percent of Gram energy in one common direction and has effective rank 2.05; after centering its effective rank is 68.50 and the leading energy fraction is 9.01 percent.
text_direction_gauge.registered_change: Both fit and dev embeddings are transformed deterministically as normalize(t - mean(T)) after strict artifact and SHA validation.
text_direction_gauge.reason: The objective must preserve discriminative contrast directions rather than the shared text embedding component.

corrected_query_free_controls.bank: centered target-blind ImageNet-1K dev split with 101 queries
corrected_query_free_controls.interpretation: Centered generic directions reduce the apparent V2/V3 gap; they remain a target-blind objective and regression gate, not evidence that the deployment OOD failure is solved.

deployment_ood_gate.finding: The failed Figurines sentinel has reliability, raw feature norm, normalized geometry distance, and support-fill statistics far outside the ScanNet cache distribution; the actual V3-to-teacher descriptor cosine is only 0.760 to 0.810 across scales.
deployment_ood_gate.rule: Passing the corrected generic gate authorizes only the already-frozen Figurines sentinel. It does not authorize expansion unless the sentinel reaches 0.4803371775 mIoU. Failure rejects the objective-only branch without benchmark tuning.
deployment_ood_gate.longer_term_candidate: A new contract version must repair the inactive context budget and use a frozen V2-compatible base with a bounded query-free OOD-gated residual; V3 semantics and hashes must remain unchanged.
